```{r} 
#| label: set-up
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(ipdw)
library(knitr)

## Load packages and functions from setup script
source(here::here("3-scripts", "1-functions.r"))

trg_crs <- "EPSG:6440" # NAD 83 Florida State Plane North 

data_dir <- here::here("2-data","processed")
rast_dir <- here::here("2-data","rasters")
table_dir <- here::here("4-tables-and-figures", "tables")


study_area <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "study_area.rds")) %>%
  st_transform(trg_crs)

study_extent <- study_area %>%
  st_bbox() %>%
  st_as_sfc() %>%
  st_buffer(1000)


# Load Processed Data
chla_proc <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir,"chla_proc.rds")) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)
sal_proc <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "sal_proc.rds")) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)
water_temp_proc <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "water_temp_proc.rds")) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)
do_proc <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "do_proc.rds")) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)
turb_proc <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir,"turb_proc.rds")) %>% st_transform(trg_crs)

# Load Prediction Rasters
sal_rast <- rast(file.path(rast_dir,"rast_sal.tif"))
water_temp_rast <- rast(file.path(rast_dir,"rast_wTemp.tif"))
do_rast <- rast(file.path(rast_dir,"rast_do.tif"))
turb_rast <- rast(file.path(rast_dir,"rast_turb.tif")) 

```

# 1. Create Table of Observed vs Predicted Parameters

```{r}
#| label: obs-vs-pred-param-vals

# helper function to summarize observed and predicted values
summarize_parameter <- function(
  observed,
  predicted,
  parameter,
  units
) {

  # observed values from processed monitoring data
  obs_vals <- observed %>%
    sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
    dplyr::pull(mean)

  # predicted raster values
  pred_stats <- terra::global(
    predicted,
    fun = c("min", "mean", "max"),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    Parameter = parameter,
    Units = units,

    `Observed Min` = min(obs_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Observed Mean` = mean(obs_vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Observed Max` = max(obs_vals, na.rm = TRUE),

    `Predicted Min` = pred_stats$min,
    `Predicted Mean` = pred_stats$mean,
    `Predicted Max` = pred_stats$max
  )
}

comparison_tbl <- dplyr::bind_rows(

  summarize_parameter(
    sal_proc,
    sal_rast,
    "Salinity",
    "ppt"
  ),

  summarize_parameter(
    water_temp_proc,
    water_temp_rast,
    "Water Temperature",
    "°C"
  ),

  summarize_parameter(
    do_proc,
    do_rast,
    "Dissolved Oxygen",
    "mg/L"
  ),

  summarize_parameter(
    turb_proc,
    turb_rast,
    "Turbidity",
    "FTU"
  )
)

comparison_tbl <- comparison_tbl %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Observed Min` = round(`Observed Min`, 2),
    `Observed Mean` = round(`Observed Mean`, 2),
    `Observed Max` = round(`Observed Max`, 2),
    `Predicted Min` = round(`Predicted Min`, 2),
    `Predicted Mean` = round(`Predicted Mean`, 2),
    `Predicted Max` = round(`Predicted Max`, 2)
    )
  
saveRDS(comparison_tbl, file.path(table_dir, "Obs-Pred-Comparison.rds"))  
  
comparison_tbl %>%
  knitr::kable(
    align = c("l", "l", rep("r", 6))
  )
